name: Measured text
responsibility: Measures every card, note and label in the faces the core carries
description: The core shapes every run with archboard-text and breaks it at a width, so a width is never estimated and never asked of the place that draws (ADR 0059, TASK-520.07). Every layout and every painter read the same numbers here. The sequence grammar wraps its responsibilities and step notes with the same line breaking.

outgoing.label: shape words and break them to a width
